stations.title: Shop files
stations.text: Orders, a log and dozens of messages.

stations.title: Top folder
stations.text: The lines Idris asked for, and one count.

captions: At Ashgrove, Idris needs answers that sit inside the order file, the log and the messages.
There are hundreds of lines, and reading them all by eye would take the whole day.
You search inside the files for words, in four small tasks.
Each answer is saved: the lines that match, where they are, or how many.
Idris knows who ordered, who has not paid and which parcels went astray.
